description: Use when the user wants to see when they can book, or when an owner asks when they can fit a job in (pass their own business id). For the selections from catalog: live open times, the same for every kind of business. A table or class is quantity = party. A person is optional: who is a wish, only_who makes it firm. When request_only is true no times are promised: use request_booking. Nothing is held until book confirms.

date.description: Business-local YYYY-MM-DD. Without it, the coming week

only_who.description: Only this person: fewer times, but it stays with them

repeat.description: Weekly, biweekly or monthly, when the customer asked for it. It may change the price

fields.description: Answers to the item's fields, by field id

quantity.description: How many: the party size for a table or a class

who.description: Who they'd like, by name, from the catalog's team. A wish: someone else may take it, unless only_who

name: find_times
title: Find open times
